how_it_works.title: How SomeoneThere works
how_it_works.step_1_body: You find the rental yourself, anywhere — Idealista, Facebook, an agency, a WhatsApp message. You paste the link or type the address.
how_it_works.step_2_body: Damp, noise, the real size of the bedroom, whether the listing photos match. You choose, and you can add your own questions.
how_it_works.step_3_body: A trusted local goes to the viewing in person, with the property contact's agreement, and you join by video call.
how_it_works.step_4_body: Observations, listing differences, answers to your questions, and an explicit list of what could not be checked.
how_it_works.limits_body: SomeoneThere is not a real-estate agency, a legal advisor, an escrow service, or a certified property inspection. A verifier records what they observed during one visit. Conditions may change afterwards.

legal.limitations_body: SomeoneThere sends a trusted local to a viewing and records what they observed. SomeoneThere is not a real-estate agency, a broker, a legal advisor, a contract-review provider, an escrow service, or a certified property inspector, and does not guarantee that a property or a landlord is legitimate. A report describes one visit at one moment. Conditions may change afterwards, and some things cannot be checked at all during a viewing — those are listed explicitly in every report.

notifications.permission_body: We'll tell you when access is confirmed, when your verifier arrives, and when your report is ready.
